translations.idiomatic: At Qianfu's start, floods brought famine to Shandong.

sentences.zh: 中官田令孜為神策中尉，怙權用事，督賦益急。

translations.literal: The eunuch Tian Lingzi was Shence army director, relying on power to handle affairs, pressing levies ever more urgently.
translations.idiomatic: Eunuch Tian Lingzi, Shence director, abused power and squeezed taxes ever harder.

sentences.zh: 王仙芝、黃巢等起，天下遂亂，公私困竭。

translations.literal: Wang Xianzhi, Huang Chao, and others rose; the realm was soon in chaos, public and private exhausted.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Xianzhi and Huang Chao rose; the empire collapsed and treasuries emptied.

sentences.zh: 昭宗在鳳翔，為梁兵所圍，城中人相食，父食其子，而天子食粥，六宮及宗室多餓死。

translations.literal: Zhaozong was at Fengxiang, besieged by Liang troops; in the city people ate one another, fathers eating their sons, while the Son of Heaven ate gruel; the six palaces and the imperial clan mostly starved to death.
translations.idiomatic: Besieged at Fengxiang by Liang forces, Zhaozong ate gruel while the court starved; the city turned to cannibalism.

sentences.zh: 其窮至於如此，遂以亡。

translations.literal: Poverty reached this point, and thus the dynasty perished.
translations.idiomatic: Destitution reached this point—and the dynasty fell.

sentences.zh: 初，乾元末，天下上計百六十九州，戶百九十三萬三千一百二十四，不課者百一十七萬四千五百九十二；

translations.literal: At first, at the end of Qianyuan, the realm reported 169 prefectures, 1,933,124 households, with 1,174,592 not paying tax;
translations.idiomatic: In late Qianyuan the empire reported 169 prefectures and 1,933,124 households, 1,174,592 non-taxable;

sentences.zh: 口千六百九十九萬三百八十六，不課者千四百六十一萬九千五百八十七。

translations.literal: population 16,990,386, with 14,619,587 not paying.
translations.idiomatic: and 16,990,386 persons, 14,619,587 non-taxable.

sentences.zh: 減天寶戶五百九十八萬二千五百八十四，口三千五百九十二萬八千七百二十三。

translations.literal: A decrease from Tianbao of 5,982,584 households and 35,928,723 persons.
translations.idiomatic: This was 5,982,584 fewer households and 35,928,723 fewer persons than Tianbao.

sentences.zh: 元和中，供歲賦者，浙西、浙東、宣歙、淮南、江西、鄂岳、福建、湖南八道，戶百四十四萬，比天寶纔四之一。

translations.literal: In the Yuanhe era, those supplying yearly levies were the eight circuits of Zhexi, Zhedong, Xuan-She, Huainan, Jiangxi, E-Yue, Fujian, and Hunan—1,440,000 households, only one-fourth of Tianbao.
translations.idiomatic: By Yuanhe only eight southeastern circuits—1,440,000 households—paid annual levies, a quarter of Tianbao levels.

sentences.zh: 兵食於官者八十三萬，加天寶三之一，通以二戶養一兵。

translations.literal: Soldiers fed by the government numbered 830,000, an increase of one-third over Tianbao; generally two households supported one soldier.
translations.idiomatic: Government-fed troops reached 830,000, a third above Tianbao—two households per soldier.

sentences.zh: 京西北、河北以屯兵廣，無上供。

translations.literal: Northwest of the capital and Hebei, because garrison troops were extensive, there was no tribute to the center.
translations.idiomatic: The capital northwest and Hebei, thick with garrisons, sent no central tribute.

sentences.zh: 至長慶，戶三百三十五萬，而兵九十九萬，率三戶以奉一兵。

translations.literal: By Changqing, households 3,350,000 and soldiers 990,000—on average three households supporting one soldier.
translations.idiomatic: By Changqing, 3,350,000 households supported 990,000 soldiers—three households per soldier.

sentences.zh: 至武宗即位，戶二百一十一萬四千九百六十。

translations.literal: By Wuzong's accession, households 2,114,960.
translations.idiomatic: At Wuzong's accession: 2,114,960 households.

sentences.zh: 會昌末，戶增至四百九十五萬五千一百五十一。

translations.literal: By late Huichang, households increased to 4,955,151.
translations.idiomatic: By late Huichang: 4,955,151 households.

sentences.zh: 宣宗既復河、湟，天下兩稅、榷酒茶鹽錢，歲入九百二十二萬緡，歲之常費率少三百餘萬，有司遠取後年乃濟。

translations.literal: After Xuanzong recovered the He and Huang regions, yearly intake of two taxes and wine, tea, and salt monopoly money was 9,220,000 strings; regular yearly expenses on average fell short by more than three million, and offices took from later years to make ends meet.
translations.idiomatic: After Xuanzong recovered the northwest, annual revenue from two taxes and monopolies reached 9.22 million strings, yet routine spending still ran three million short—offices borrowed from future years.

sentences.zh: 及羣盜起，諸鎮不復上計云。

translations.literal: When bandits rose in numbers, the various circuits no longer reported accounts.
translations.idiomatic: When widespread rebellion broke out, circuits ceased reporting accounts altogether.
